segments.text: Thirty percent of luxury flats had no area listed. We filled the blanks with the average.
segments.caption: 30% of luxury flats had no area listed. We filled the blanks with the average.

segments.text: And our model started underpricing every luxury flat by forty lakh.
segments.caption: And our model started underpricing every luxury flat by 40 lakh.

segments.text: The blanks weren't random. Luxury sellers often hide the size. So filling with the average shrank exactly the flats that mattered most.
segments.caption: The blanks weren't random. Luxury sellers often hide the size. So filling with the average shrank exactly the flats that mattered most.

segments.text: Day seven of 100 Days of Machine Learning: missing values. The three types, six fixes, and the one rule most beginners break.
segments.caption: Day 7 of 100 Days of Machine Learning: missing values. The 3 types, 6 fixes, and the one rule most beginners break.

segments.text: Before fixing anything, measure.
segments.caption: Before fixing anything, measure.

segments.text: Count the percentage missing in every column. Then check which gaps appear together. Here, floor and age are missing in the same new projects.
segments.caption: Count the percentage missing in every column. Then check which gaps appear together. Here, floor and age are missing in the same new projects.

segments.text: Next, ask why it's missing. There are three types.
segments.caption: Next, ask why it's missing. There are 3 types.

segments.text: Missing completely at random: a website glitch wiped some rows. Harmless.
segments.caption: Missing completely at random: a website glitch wiped some rows. Harmless.

segments.text: Missing at random: it depends on another column. New projects don't list the building age, because it's zero.
segments.caption: Missing at random: it depends on another column. New projects don't list the building age, because it's zero.

segments.text: Missing not at random: it depends on the missing value itself. Luxury sellers hide the size. This one is dangerous.
segments.caption: Missing not at random: it depends on the missing value itself. Luxury sellers hide the size. This one is dangerous.

segments.text: Fix one: drop the rows.
segments.caption: Fix 1: drop the rows.

segments.text: Fine when only a few rows are missing, and the gaps are random. Under five percent is a common guide. But drop rows that are missing for a reason, and you delete a whole group from your data.
segments.caption: Fine when only a few rows are missing, and the gaps are random. Under 5% is a common guide. But drop rows that are missing for a reason, and you delete a whole group from your data.

segments.text: Fix two: drop the column.
segments.caption: Fix 2: drop the column.

segments.text: If a column is mostly empty, like seventy percent, and not important, filling it is mostly guessing. Let it go.
segments.caption: If a column is mostly empty, like 70%, and not important, filling it is mostly guessing. Let it go.

segments.text: Fix three: fill with the median, not the mean.
segments.caption: Fix 3: fill with the median, not the mean.

segments.text: Prices and areas are skewed. A few huge villas pull the mean up. The median stays a typical value.
segments.caption: Prices and areas are skewed. A few huge villas pull the mean up. The median stays a typical value.

segments.text: Fix four, much better: fill by group.
segments.caption: Fix 4, much better: fill by group.

segments.text: A missing area for a 3 BHK in Koramangala gets the median of other 3 BHKs in Koramangala, not the median of the whole city.
segments.caption: A missing area for a 3 BHK in Koramangala gets the median of other 3 BHKs in Koramangala, not the median of the whole city.

segments.text: Fix five: predict the missing value.
segments.caption: Fix 5: predict the missing value.

segments.text: Use the other columns, like bedrooms, bathrooms and floor, to estimate it. Methods like KNN or iterative imputation do this for you.
segments.caption: Use the other columns, like bedrooms, bathrooms and floor, to estimate it. Methods like KNN or iterative imputation do this for you.

segments.text: Fix six, the secret weapon: add a flag.
segments.caption: Fix 6, the secret weapon: add a flag.

segments.text: Create a column that says area was missing, yes or no. Remember our luxury sellers? That flag alone tells the model: this flat is probably big.
segments.caption: Create a column that says area was missing, yes or no. Remember our luxury sellers? That flag alone tells the model: this flat is probably big.

segments.text: Now the rule most beginners break.
segments.caption: Now the rule most beginners break.

segments.text: Calculate your medians and group values from the training data only, then apply them to the test data. Use the whole dataset, and test answers leak into training.
segments.caption: Calculate your medians and group values from the training data only, then apply them to the test data. Use the whole dataset, and test answers leak into training.

segments.text: So here's the decision guide.
segments.caption: So here's the decision guide.

segments.text: Few and random? Drop rows. Mostly empty? Drop the column. Otherwise, fill by group, or predict it. Always add a flag. And fit on training data only.
segments.caption: Few and random? Drop rows. Mostly empty? Drop the column. Otherwise, fill by group, or predict it. Always add a flag. And fit on training data only.

segments.text: Save this. You'll need it on every dataset.
segments.caption: Save this. You'll need it on every dataset.
